senses.gloss:
भी 1. भी, cl. 1. A. भयते (Ved.); cl. 3.
P. (Ved. and ep. also A.) बिभेति (3rd du.
बिभीतस् or बिभितस्, 3rd pl. बिभ्यति, Part. बिभ्-
यत्, ep. 1st sing. A. बिभ्ये), Impf. अबिभेत् (3rd pl.
अबिभयुस्), Pot. बिभीयात् or बिभियात् (3rd pl. बि-
भीयुस् or बिभियुस्, बिभ्येयुस् Mahā-bh. Śānti-p.
459), बिभाय or बिभयाञ्-चकार or बिभयाम्-
आस (3rd pl. बिभ्युस्, Part. बिभीवस्, बिभ्युषी, f.),
भेष्यति, Aor. अभैषीत् (2nd sing. अभैषीस्,
ep. मा भैस् for मा भैषीस्, Ved. forms भेस्,
भेम), भेतुम् (Ved. forms भयन्ते, अभयन्त,
Part. भयमान, भियान, Inf. भियसे, cf. भियस्
below; according to the Dhātu-pāṭha even cl. 10. P.
भाययति), to fear, dread, be afraid of (with abl. or
gen., e. g. मृत्योर् बिभेति, he fears death; बिभेमि
-ते, I fear thee; very rarely with inst. or acc.); to fear
for, be anxious or solicitous about (A.): Pass. भी-
यते, Aor. अभायि: Caus. A. भीषयते (ep. also
P. भीषयति), भापयते, Aor. अबिभीषत, &c.,
to terrify, put in a fright, intimidate; भाययति,
Aor. अबीभयत्, &c., to frighten or terrify any one
(acc.) with anything (inst.): Desid. बिभीषति:
Intens. बेभीयते, बेभयीति, बेभेति; [cf. Zend
rt. बी, ‘to be frightened:’ Gr. φέβ-ο-μαι, φόβο-ς,
φοβέ-ω, φοβέ-ο-μαι, φοβ-ερό-ς: Lith. bij-au, ‘I
am afraid;’ baime, ‘fear;’ bai-dau, ‘I terrify;’
baisis, ‘terrible;’ perhaps belonging to the Caus.
भीषय; byaurùs, ‘deformed,’ see भीरु; baj-
us, ‘fear,’ = भय: Slav. boj-a-ti, ‘to be afraid:’
probably Goth. fia for bia, fiangds: Mod. Germ.
feind: Eng. fiend: Old Germ. bi-bê-n: Angl. Sax.
bif-ian, beof-ian: Mod. Germ. beb-en = Intens.
बेभेति.]

2. भी, ईस्, f. fear, apprehension, alarm, dread,
[]
(sometimes at the end of a comp., cf. अवद्य-भी.)
—भी-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing or exciting
fear.
—भी-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, fearful.
